headline: Agoda Reveals Growing Interest in Cool-Weather Destinations in Japan for Summer 2026
summary: Agoda Company Pte. Ltd. (Headquarters: Singapore; CEO: Omri Morgenshtern), which operates the digital travel platform Agoda, has revealed growing interest among Japanese travelers in domestic cool-weather destinations for late summer 2026, based on accommodation search data.
